name: Meridian Review
description: Long-form writing on streets, stations and the maps that explain them. Published by Meridian Cartographic.

blog.title: Meridian Review
blog.description: Essays on how cities move, and how to draw them so people can find their way.

changelog.title: Meridian Atlas updates
changelog.description: Release notes for Meridian Atlas, the tool our cartographers use to draw transit diagrams.

ines.name: Inés Carvalho
ines.title: Editor
ines.bio: Edits the Review. Spent nine years planning bus networks in Lisbon and Porto before moving to maps.

tomasz.name: Tomasz Wróbel
tomasz.title: Senior cartographer
tomasz.bio: Draws the night and regional network maps at Meridian. Rides every line before it goes to print.

adaeze.name: Adaeze Nwosu
adaeze.title: Contributing writer
adaeze.bio: Urban planner in Lagos and Leeds. Writes about walking, waiting and the small furniture of streets.

hal.name: Hal Brennan
hal.title: Design lead, Meridian Atlas
hal.bio: Leads design on Meridian Atlas. Previously typography for airport wayfinding.
